[SWS_CORE_03317] Forward-find of character set within a StringView
⌈
A member function shall be defined for BasicString that allows
forward-searching for any of the characters within a StringView:
size_type find_first_of(StringView sv,
size_type pos = 0) const noexcept;
This function shall behave the same as the corresponding std::basic_string func-
tion from [6, the C++17 standard].
⌋
